subject: Taxes
title: Dark Money and Tax Policy
description: One-minute skill: Dark Money and Tax Policy.

hook.text: Nonprofit organizations can spend unlimited money on political ads without revealing donors.

buildup.text: Groups like Americans for Prosperity and the Chamber of Commerce fund campaigns for lower corporate taxes.

discovery.text: Dark money spending on tax-related campaigns exceeds $500 million per election cycle.

twist.text: The nonprofits that channel dark money are themselves tax-exempt.

climax.text: Dark money makes it impossible to know who truly shapes tax policy. The influence is invisible by design.

punchline.text: Tax-exempt groups fighting to lower taxes. The irony is the design.

quiz.question: What is 'dark money' in the context of tax policy?
options: Undisclosed donations used to influence tax policy through nonprofits
Tax revenue from the black market
